title: Acknowledgments
text: ACKNOWLEDGMENTS Thanks to Nancy Buchanan, first reader and first librarian, without whom most of my books would not have titles. Thanks to my husband Troyce, and friends Megan, Beth E., Felicia, Lisa, Bill, and Beth L., and everyone else who read versions of this in its rough form and kept me going until it was finished.
